text:
alex: Quick heads-up — starting a cross-region perf sweep for Llama / Mistral / Qwen. Main goals: ROPE behavior at large context, GQA performance differences, and 4k vs 32k context sizing. Targets: eu-frankfurt H100, us-west A100, us-east H100.

mira: Nice. Baseline configs?

alex: Baseline: batch=1, tokens=2048/4096/32768, kv-cache warmed, runs both fp16 and int8 (per-model quant flags). Kernel candidates: `fused_attn_v2`, `flash_attn`, fallback generic. Collect P50/P95 latency + tokens/s, and GPU util.

tariq: Heads up — I'm seeing ROPE slowdown on H100 when seq > 8k for Mistral. Kernel selector falls back to generic attention (huge perf loss). Log snippet: 

```
kernel_selector: model=Mistral-7B, seq_len=16384, selected_kernel=generic_attention, reason=rope_scale_mismatch
fallback_note: flash_attn not compatible with rope_stride=4
```

jen: can you paste the exact cmd+env you used?

tariq: `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python bench.py --model=mistral --seq=16384 --kernel=auto --quant=int8`

mira: That looks like the kernel-mapping table doesn't include the scaled-rope path. I can repro on eu-h100. Qwen uses a different rope encode so flash_attn stays happy; Llama has GQA regressions when quantized (p95 jumps).

alex: Quick numbers from a short run (tokens/s, batch=1):

- Llama-13B (A100 us-west): seq2k=1200, seq32k=85
- Mistral-7B (H100 eu): seq2k=1600, seq32k=70
- Qwen-14B (H100 us-east): seq2k=1400, seq32k=95

P50 latencies roughly track inverse, but Mistral p95 spikes on 32k due to fallback.

leo: Interesting: eu H100 shows ~12% higher small-seq latency vs us-west A100 for some models; for 32k it's closer. Driver/stack mismatch? eu h100s are on driver 535.x, us-east on 540.x — could affect kernel availability. Also check CUDA vs cuBLAS versions.

mira: Action items: 1) add kernel mapping for `rope_scaled` -> `fused_attn_v3` in kernel_selector, 2) run quantized GQA eval on us-east H100 with same driver, 3) re-run same experiments with `--prefer-flash` and `--no-fallback` to capture failure modes. I'll pick up 1 & 3.

alex: Filed ticket INTERNAL-ML-2897 for the kernel mapping + repro data. Tagging infra folks for driver parity.

bench-bot: Sweep started: run_id=INTERNAL-ML-2897-1, targets=[eu-h100, us-east-h100, us-west-a100], expected_finish=2h.

tariq: Quick note — Qwen's rope encoding seems more tolerant of quantization; GQA delta is ~3% for int8 vs fp16, while Llama hits ~12% regression on quality. We'll need model-specific quant configs.

jen: For capacity planning: with consistent kernels, tokens/s suggests we can fit ~650 concurrent seq2k Llama workers on a single a100 node before latency SLO degrades. But with fallback issues on H100, that drops to ~300. So kernel correctness directly impacts capacity numbers.

mira: I'll upload the full run logs to the ticket, including `kernel_selector` traces and driver versions. Also adding a small repro script to flip `rope_stride` and see kernel choices.

alex: Great — once we have kernel patch + driver parity we should re-run full EU<>US sweep and update the per-region routing policy (maybe prefer A100 for Llama-high-context until patch ships).

bench-bot: Sweep update: eu-h100 completed (20/24 jobs), failing jobs show `fallback=generic_attention`.

leo: Remote debugging tip — set `RUNTIME_DEBUG=kernel_map` to see candidate kernels and match heuristics. Saved me last time.

jen: OK folks, prioritize kernel mapping and driver parity. If anyone needs spare eu-h100 machines for repro, I can allocate one for a morning. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks — looping in infra in the ticket.
